# RR Metrics

> RR Metrics is a trading journal web app for futures, stocks, and options traders. It provides trade logging, analytics, broker imports (Tradovate, Topstep, NinjaTrader, CSV), equity curves, tag-based performance tracking, and a pre-market planner.

## Product Guides

- [Getting Started](https://rrmetrics.com/guides/getting-started.md): Quick start guide for adding your first trades
- [Dashboard Walkthrough](https://rrmetrics.com/guides/dashboard-walkthrough.md): Full walkthrough of the trading dashboard
- [Analytics](https://rrmetrics.com/guides/analytics.md): Understanding your analytics and performance metrics
- [Tags](https://rrmetrics.com/guides/tags.md): Using tags to categorize and filter trades
- [Strategy](https://rrmetrics.com/guides/strategy.md): Setting up strategy checklists and playbooks
- [Pre-Market Planner](https://rrmetrics.com/guides/premarket.md): Daily pre-market preparation tool
- [Data Export](https://rrmetrics.com/guides/data-export.md): Exporting your trade data
- [Subscription](https://rrmetrics.com/guides/subscription.md): Plans, pricing, and account management
- [Copytrading](https://rrmetrics.com/guides/copytrading.md): Copy trading features and setup

## Broker Import Guides

- [Tradovate Import](https://rrmetrics.com/guides/tradovate-import.md): Import trades from Tradovate
- [Topstep Import](https://rrmetrics.com/guides/topstep-import.md): Import trades from Topstep / ProjectX
- [NinjaTrader API](https://rrmetrics.com/guides/ninjatrader-api.md): Connect NinjaTrader via API
- [Generic CSV](https://rrmetrics.com/guides/generic-csv.md): Import trades from any broker via CSV
